PREFIX ?= $(HOME)/.local
BIN := $(PREFIX)/bin

all: build install

build:
	mkdir -p dist
	cp src/main.py dist/repo

install:
	mkdir -p $(BIN)
	cp dist/repo $(BIN)/repo

.PHONY: all build install

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." && pwd)"
rm -rf "$ROOT/dist" "$ROOT/.pytest_cache"
# drop the pip wheel cache too so stale wheels are not reused
rm -rf "${PIP_CACHE_DIR:-$HOME/.cache/pip}"
echo clean
